alex_support: Customer escalation — refund request triggered a duplicate charge. Autorouter chose legacy webhook_post instead of billing.refund. Ticket created, customer saw immediate charge and then a follow-up refund attempt that recharged.
ticketbot: Created ticket R-8421 · Priority: high · Link: https://redwood.support/tickets/R-8421
jamie_eng: Can you paste the raw incoming payload + request-id? Need to repro locally.
alex_support: incoming payload (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
 -d '{"tool":"post","amount":1000,"currency":"USD","reason":"customer_refund","customer_id":"cus_ABC123"}'
```
Request-ID: rq_7f3a2b
jamie_eng: Thanks. Quick glance — tool name is just "post" (ambiguous). Our tool registry has a legacy webhook named `webhook_post` with alias `post` and a newer `billing.refund` whose operationId contains `postRefund`. Toolpicker fuzzy-match prefers shorter alias and fell back to the legacy tool when schema confidence was low.
maya_sre: Ops — did we push autoroute rules on 2026-03-12? That change adjusted alias weighting, right?
ops-bot: Rolled back config: autoroute/ruleset v2026-03-12 -> v2026-02-28. Traffic back to previous weighting. No further rollouts applied. (logs: ops/rollbacks/3355551111)
jamie_eng: Root cause summary: ambiguous alias + overlapping shallow schemas. The legacy webhook accepts a generic object so schema validation passed; toolpicker selected it at ~0.61 confidence and our fallback path executes legacy webhook by default when confidence < 0.7.
jamie_eng: Repro steps locally:
1) POST payload above with header X-Tool-Auto: true
2) Observe selected tool in logs: `toolpicker.choose(rq_7f3a2b) -> webhook_post (confidence=0.61)`
3) Confirm webhook POST to external service -> duplicate charge flow
alex_support: Verified with customer after rollback — no further duplicate charges observed. They want explanation + mitigation steps.
jamie_eng: Proposed fixes (short):
- Remove ambiguous alias `post` from webhook_post; use explicit aliases `webhook.post` only.
- Increase toolpicker confidence threshold to 0.7 for destructive tools.
- Add schema precedence: tools with required field `amount.currency` should outrank generic webhooks.
- Add heuristic: if op name contains `refund` or `void`, bias toward billing namespace.
I'll open a PR with alias changes + threshold bump.
maya_sre: Also suggest an emergency rule: block auto-routing to legacy webhooks for any payload with `amount` until we finish schema gating.
ops-bot: Emergency rule applied: autoroute/blocks/temporary_block_amounts -> ENABLED
alex_support: I'll send a close-loop message to the customer and attach the ticket notes. Thanks all — please tag me when the PR merges. :thumbsup:
jamie_eng: I'll ping here once PR #3492 is merged and deployed. :white_check_mark:
alex_support: closing internal thread, marking as resolved in ticket R-8421.
